line.ko: 비행기를 오래 탔더니 목이 마르다. 편의점이 어디 있지?
line.roman: bihaenggireul orae tatdeoni mogi mareuda. pyeonuijeomi eodi itji?
line.en: Thirsty after that long flight. Where's a convenience store?

narration.en: A convenience store sign is visible at the corner of the alley.

aside.en: Looking up at the sound of the door bell.

pre_cuts.speaker: 앞손님

aside.ko: 통로를 막은 캐리어 옆으로 조심스레 몸을 비키며
aside.roman: tongroreul mageun kaerieo yeopeuro josimseure momeul bikimyeo
aside.en: Carefully squeezing past the suitcase blocking the aisle.

pre_cuts.image_brief: 캐리어를 끌고 좁은 통로를 지나가느라 진땀을 빼고 있다.

narration.ko: 안쪽으로 들어가 냉장고에서 생수를 하나 꺼내 계산대에 올린다.
narration.roman: anjjogeuro deureoga naengjanggoeseo saengsureul hana kkeonae gyesandaee ollinda.
narration.en: Goes inside, takes a bottle of water from the fridge and places it on the counter.

text.en: No, I don't need the receipt.

narration.ko: 생수를 들고 편의점을 나와 게스트하우스로 향한다.
narration.roman: saengsureul deulgo pyeonuijeomeul nawa geseuteuhauseuro hyanghanda.
narration.en: Leaves the convenience store with the water and heads to the guesthouse.
The guesthouse sign is visible further down the alley.

post_cuts.speaker: 낯선 사람

line.en: Oh, you must be new here?

aside.ko: 게스트하우스 문을 열고 들어가자, 거실에서 짐을 정리하는 낯선 사람의 뒷모습이 보인다.
aside.roman: geseuteuhauseu muneul yeolgo deureogaja, geosireseo jimeul jeongrihaneun natseon saramui dwinmoseubi boinda.
aside.en: Opening the guesthouse door, there's someone in the living room sorting through their bags, back turned.
